description:
DESIGN TALK (schema). Needs ag-s99.6 first.

Goal: a deployment is identified by repository + workflow file, as agreed in docs/00-glossary.md. The ref is recorded per run, not part of the deployment. Runs from any branch belong to the same deployment.

Today: the registration (core.Agent, agents table, JSON document) has a required Ref; validation in internal/core/validation.go:31. Matching uses it in internal/core/report.go:94 and internal/core/worker.go:49 (refMatches). The dashboard form asks for "Default Git reference" (internal/web/templates.html, agent-form) and the run page shows "Repository / ref" from the registration copy.

Work: stop matching on ref; record the run's own ref (from the OIDC identity / GitHub run) on the run; show it from the run.

Questions for Matt: what to do with existing registrations that differ only by ref (merge, or keep and mark as legacy)? Is a uniqueness rule on repository + workflow file needed in the database (new migration)?

Keep backwards compatibility: old stored documents with a ref must still load. Migrations are append-only.

comments.text: 2026-10-14: recommended answers posted to Matt in the project thread; awaiting his decision before code.

2026-10-14, Matt: existing data is only tests, it can be dropped. So no merge/legacy handling for registrations that differ by ref; a new migration may delete them and add a unique index on (repository, workflow) here rather than in ag-s99.4.

title: Identify a deployment by repository + workflow file
